lan_only.title: LAN only mode
lan_only.sub: Turn off QIDI's cloud connection and remote access, as the touchscreen's LAN Only switch does. The Qidi Joy app and QIDI account sign-in don't work while it's on. Fluidd and the slicers keep working on your network.

klipper.loading: Asking the printer which Klipper runs…

sub.qidi: The Klipper QIDI ships with the printer. The default.

code.printer_state_unknown: The printer didn't say whether a print is running. Try again in a moment.
code.run_in_progress: A Valve Oil update is running. Switch once it finishes.
code.installer_busy: Valve Oil is checking for updates or installing. Switch once it finishes.
code.firmware_update_pending: A QIDI firmware update hasn't finished. Finish it from Valve Oil's updates first.

qidi.title: Use QIDI's Klipper?
qidi.body: Klipper restarts with QIDI's Klipper, so the printer can't be used for a minute or so.

valve_oil.title: Use Valve Oil's Klipper?
valve_oil.body: Klipper restarts with Valve Oil's Klipper, so the printer can't be used for a minute or so. If it doesn't start, QIDI's Klipper starts instead, and you can go back here or with VO_KLIPPER USE=QIDI.

retry.title: Try Valve Oil's Klipper again?
retry.body: Klipper restarts and tries Valve Oil's Klipper again, so the printer can't be used for a minute or so.

klipper.footer: Switching restarts Klipper and isn't possible during a print. In the console, {{status}} says which Klipper runs, and {{valve_oil}} or {{qidi}} switches.
